names(head(sort(ligand_abundance, decreasing = TRUE), 12))  sample_state_means <- function(features, state) {   means <- vapply(sample_ids, function(sample) {     cells <- colnames(pbmc)[       as.character(pbmc$real_sample) == sample & pbmc$cell_state == state     ]     if (length(cells) == 0L) {       rep(NA_real_, length(features))     } else {       Matrix::rowMeans(expression[features, cells, drop = FALSE])     }   }, numeric(length(features)))   rownames(means) <- features   means }  ligand_by_sample <- sample_state_means(ligands, sender_state) target_pool <- setdiff(intersect(Seurat::VariableFeatures(pbmc), rownames(expression)), ligands) target_by_sample <- sample_state_means(target_pool, receiver_state) target_variance <- apply(target_by_sample, 1, stats::var, na.rm = TRUE) targets <- names(head(sort(target_variance, decreasing = TRUE), 60)) target_by_sample <- target_by_sample[targets, , drop = FALSE]  ligand_targets <- expand.grid(   ligand = ligands,   target_gene = targets,   stringsAsFactors = FALSE ) ligand_targets$weight <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(ligand_targets)), function(index) {   stats::cor(     ligand_by_sample[ligand_targets$ligand[[index]], ],     target_by_sample[ligand_targets$target_gene[[index]], ],     method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"   ) }, numeric(1)) ligand_targets <- ligand_targets[is.finite(ligand_targets$weight), , drop = FALSE] ligand_targets <- ligand_targets[   order(abs(ligand_targets$weight), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE ] text: sn_initialize_seurat_object() calls sn_add_qc_metrics() internally. can also refresh percentages existing object without initializing : correction workflow replaced RNA counts layer, call recalculates percentages current counts. corrected counts stored separately, select assay/layer explicitly: suffix = NULL (default), layer = "decontaminated_counts" individual decontaminated_counts.* split layer automatically adds _corrected, preserving original QC columns: layers, including counts, keep empty suffix default overwrite percent.mt, percent.ribo, percent.hb. explicit suffix always wins: use suffix = "" overwrite original columns even decontaminated counts, suffix = "_corrected" choose different suffix. Species can omitted stored object inferable selected assay. Use gene symbols count values, normalized scaled expression. helper recomputes denominator selected counts, stale nCount_* metadata affect percentages. refresh nCount_* nFeature_*, modify count layers, change default assay. exact layer name takes precedence split layers. Otherwise, name counts selects disjoint counts.* layers without joining materializing BPCells matrices. Overlapping cell sets rejected; choose one exact layer case. Cells outside selected layers receive NA. Absent marker genes give zero positive-total cells; zero-total cells give NaN percentages undefined. Mitochondrial/ribosomal signatures human/mouse hemoglobin matching unchanged initialization. gene identifiers mixed symbol styles concern, standardize initialization call sn_standardize_gene_symbols() downstream analysis. HGNChelper provide unambiguous replacement otherwise valid symbol, Shennong preserves original symbol instead returning NA feature name. symbol-correction example extended step requires optional HGNChelper snapshot. Core preprocessing retains source symbols shows exact call without installing package rendering.

what: Discover latent programs in real malignant cells
title: Program Discovery and Gene Regulatory Networks
text: fixture retains study’s inferred-CNV malignancy class. select 300 variable genes among malignant cells run four NMF programs three seeded restarts. Every weight activity value printed fitted article build.
code: library(Shennong)  melanoma <- qs2::qs_read(melanoma_path) malignant <- subset(   melanoma,   cells = colnames(melanoma)[melanoma$malignant_call == "malignant"] ) expression <- SeuratObject::LayerData(   malignant, assay = "RNA", layer = "data" ) gene_variance <- Matrix::rowMeans(expression ^ 2) -   Matrix::rowMeans(expression) ^ 2 program_features <- names(head(sort(gene_variance, decreasing = TRUE), 300))  data.frame(   tumors = length(unique(malignant$tumor)),   malignant_cells = ncol(malignant),   measured_genes = nrow(malignant),   fitted_genes = length(program_features) ) programs <- sn_discover_programs(   malignant,   method = "nmf",   n_programs = 4,   result_id = "melanoma_programs",   assay = "RNA",   layer = "data",   features = program_features,   backend_control = list(     nrun = 3L,     max_iter = 120L,     top_genes = 25L,     seed = 717L   ),   return_object = FALSE )  head(programs$tables$gene_weights, 20) programs$tables$fit_diagnostics programs$tables$stability sn_plot_discovered_programs(programs, type = "weights", n = 10) sn_plot_discovered_programs(programs, type = "activity") sn_plot_discovered_programs(programs, type = "stability")

code: if (requireNamespace("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {   counts <- matrix(rpois(20 * 24, lambda = 1), nrow = 20, ncol = 24)   rownames(counts) <- c(     paste0("GENE", 1:14),     "CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"   )   colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", 1:24)   counts[c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC"), 1:12] <-     counts[c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC"), 1:12] + 20   counts[c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"), 13:24] <-     counts[c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"), 13:24] + 20    obj <- sn_initialize_seurat_object(counts, species = "human")   obj$cell_type <- rep(c("Tcell", "Bcell"), each = 12)   Seurat::Idents(obj) <- obj$cell_type   obj <- Seurat::NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)    marker_result <- sn_find_de(     obj,     analysis = "markers",     group_by = "cell_type",     layer = "data",     min_pct = 0,     logfc_threshold = 0,     return_object = FALSE,     verbose = FALSE   )   head(sn_get_de_result(marker_result))    obj <- sn_find_de(     obj,     analysis = "markers",     group_by = "cell_type",     layer = "data",     min_pct = 0,     logfc_threshold = 0,     result_id = "celltype_markers",     return_object = TRUE,     verbose = FALSE   )   sn_list_results(obj, type = "de")   sn_get_result(obj, type = "de", result_id = "celltype_markers") }  bulk_counts <- matrix(   stats::rpois(40 * 6, 20), nrow = 40,   dimnames = list(paste0("gene_", 1:40), paste0("sample_", 1:6)) ) bulk_metadata <- data.frame(   condition = factor(rep(c("control", "treated"), each = 3)),   row.names = colnames(bulk_counts) ) bulk_de <- sn_find_de(   bulk_counts,   metadata = bulk_metadata,   design = ~condition,   contrast = c("condition", "treated", "control"),   backend_control = list(result = data.frame(     gene = rownames(bulk_counts), logFC = 0, PValue = 1, FDR = 1   )) )

title: Find doublets with scDblFinder or Scrublet — sn_find_doublets
text: object Seurat object. method Doublet-detection backend. One "scdblfinder" (default) "scrublet". clusters Optional cluster assignments. metadata column name one value per cell. Explicit assignments take precedence cluster_backend. scDblFinder-specific; ignored scrublet. cluster_backend Clustering implementation used clusters NULL. "native" (default) lets scDblFinder perform automatic clustering. "shennong" first obtains assignments sn_run_cluster() using selected assay layer. scDblFinder-specific; ignored scrublet. group_by optional metadata column used donor sample grouping. scDblFinder-specific; ignored scrublet. dbr_sd numeric value adjusting doublet rate; see scDblFinder documentation. scDblFinder-specific; ignored scrublet. n_workers Number sample groups process concurrently. BPCells backend, n_workers = 1 materializes one sample-sized sparse matrix time gives lowest peak memory use. Higher values can hold n_workers sample matrices memory concurrently. scDblFinder-specific; ignored scrublet. assay Assay used doublet detection. Defaults "RNA". layer Layer used input count matrix. Defaults "counts". Scrublet requires raw counts: non-"counts" layer stops error instead silently scoring normalized values. min_features Minimum number detected features required cell enter doublet detection. Defaults 200. Cells threshold skipped retain NA output columns. backend_control Optional named list backend-specific settings. scrublet: seed, n_prin_comps, expected_doublet_rate, synthetic_doublet_umi_subsampling, min_counts, min_cells, min_gene_variability_pctl, threshold_min, threshold_max, output_dir, runtime_dir, keep_run_dir, quiet. Default Scrublet runs use unique package-owned temporary directory remove import. explicit output_dir retained keep_run_dir = TRUE (default explicit path); keep_run_dir = FALSE, parent isolated child never recursively deleted. Ignored scDblFinder.

Use NULL disable geometry evidence. n_neighbor_clusters Number nearest clusters report reduction centroid distances. background Optional study-specific background information provide additional interpretation context. annotation_mode Annotation workflow mode. "single_pass" sends one compact prompt. "agentic" runs broad-pass annotation followed focused refinement pass ambiguous ILC-relevant clusters, reconciles result canonical lineage hints. output_format One "llm" model-ready prompt bundle "human" human-readable summary. provider Optional model provider function. left NULL, Shennong try construct ellmer-backed provider OPENAI_API_KEY plus optional OPENAI_BASE_URL OPENAI_MODEL environment variables. model Optional model identifier. reasoning_effort Optional reasoning effort forwarded compatible GPT-5 chat-completions providers, example "minimal", "low", "medium", "high", "xhigh" upstream endpoint supports . include_json_schema Logical; whether request structured JSON output provider. Defaults TRUE annotation workflows. apply_metadata Logical; TRUE structured annotation response returned, map cluster labels back onto cell Seurat metadata. metadata_prefix Prefix used metadata columns written back Seurat object apply_metadata = TRUE. metadata_fields Annotation fields write back Seurat metadata apply_metadata = TRUE. Defaults core fields : primary_label, broad_label, confidence, status, risk_flags. Detailed evidence remains stored interpretation table object@misc. label_candidates Optional vector candidate cell-type labels broad lineages treated annotation priors sorted enriched datasets. injected prompt constraints, model may still return broader label evidence weak. label_style Naming style used normalize returned cell-type labels. One "title", "snake", "asis". return_prompt TRUE, return prompt bundle without calling provider. result_id Stable identifier stored interpretation result. return_object TRUE, return updated Seurat object. show_progress Logical; TRUE, emit step-wise progress logs , cli available, console progress bar waiting LLM response. ... title: Interpret cluster markers for cell-type annotation — sn_interpret_annotation
code: if (requireNamespace("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {   counts <- matrix(rpois(20 * 24, lambda = 1), nrow = 20, ncol = 24)   rownames(counts) <- c(     paste0("GENE", 1:14),     "CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"   )   colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", 1:24)   counts[c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC"), 1:12] <-     counts[c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC"), 1:12] + 20   counts[c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"), 13:24] <-     counts[c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"), 13:24] + 20   obj <- sn_initialize_seurat_object(counts, species = "human")   obj$cell_type <- rep(c("Tcell", "Bcell"), each = 12)   Seurat::Idents(obj) <- obj$cell_type   obj <- Seurat::NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)   obj <- sn_find_de(obj, analysis = "markers", group_by = "cell_type",     layer = "data", min_pct = 0, logfc_threshold = 0,     result_id = "celltype_markers", return_object = TRUE, verbose = FALSE   )   prompt <- sn_interpret_annotation(     obj,     de_result_id = "celltype_markers",     cluster_by = "cell_type",     return_prompt = TRUE   )   prompt$task }

code: if (requireNamespace("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {   counts <- matrix(rpois(20 * 24, lambda = 1), nrow = 20, ncol = 24)   rownames(counts) <- c(     paste0("GENE", 1:14),     "CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC", "MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"   )   colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", 1:24)   counts[c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC"), 1:12] <-     counts[c("CD3D", "CD3E", "TRAC"), 1:12] + 20   counts[c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"), 13:24] <-     counts[c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "HLA-DRA"), 13:24] + 20   obj <- sn_initialize_seurat_object(counts, species = "human")   obj$cell_type <- rep(c("Tcell", "Bcell"), each = 12)   Seurat::Idents(obj) <- obj$cell_type   obj <- Seurat::NormalizeData(obj, verbose = FALSE)   obj <- sn_find_de(obj, analysis = "markers", group_by = "cell_type",     layer = "data", min_pct = 0, logfc_threshold = 0,     result_id = "celltype_markers", return_object = TRUE, verbose = FALSE   )   evidence <- sn_prepare_annotation_evidence(     obj,     de_result_id = "celltype_markers",     cluster_by = "cell_type"   )   names(evidence) }

title: Run bulk RNA-seq deconvolution with single-cell references — sn_run_bulk_deconvolution
code: if (requireNamespace("Seurat", quietly = TRUE)) {   counts <- matrix(rpois(20 * 18, lambda = 3), nrow = 20, ncol = 18)   rownames(counts) <- paste0("gene", seq_len(20))   colnames(counts) <- paste0("cell", seq_len(18))   ref <- sn_initialize_seurat_object(counts, species = "human")   ref$cell_type <- rep(c("Tcell", "Bcell", "Mono"), each = 6)   bulk <- cbind(     sample_a = rowSums(counts[, 1:12, drop = FALSE]),     sample_b = rowSums(counts[, 7:18, drop = FALSE])   )   bundle <- sn_run_bulk_deconvolution(     ref,     bulk = bulk,     method = "cibersortx",     cell_type_by = "cell_type",     outdir = tempdir(),     cibersortx_email = "demo@example.org",     cibersortx_token = "fake-token",     cibersortx_dry_run = TRUE,     return_object = FALSE   )   names(bundle$files) }

Scalar analysis parameters supplied vectors expanded conditional Cartesian grid; parameters naturally vector-valued, dims, hvg_features, vars_to_regress, block_genes, remain intact. Supported integration backends "harmony", "coralysis", "seurat_cca", "seurat_rpca", "scvi", "scanvi", "scpoli", "bbknn", "totalvi". "scvi", "scanvi", "scpoli" export selected assay/layer count matrix pixi-managed environment ~/.shennong/pixi/, run Python backend, import latent representation Seurat reduction. "bbknn" computes batch-balanced graph selected-layer PCA uses graph directly clustering UMAP. "coralysis", use icp_args RunParallelDivisiveICP() arguments, pca_args RunPCA() arguments, store_sce = FALSE trained Coralysis SingleCellExperiment kept object@misc$coralysis. default store_sce = TRUE native Coralysis references can used directly sn_transfer_labels(method = "coralysis"). "mmochi" additionally accepts protein_layer, single_peaks, marker_bandwidths, peak_overrides, inclusion_mask, landmark_args, corrected_layer, store_corrected_layer, single_sample_batch_key, keep_single_sample_batch; Shennong runs MMoCHi's ADT landmark registration imports corrected protein matrix protein-derived reduction. batch_by = NULL, Shennong uses constant internal backend batch key single-sample registration. Multiple values create separate preprocessing/embedding branches parameter-grid run. hvg_features Optional character vector user-supplied features force selected backend feature set. PCA-based workflows also feature set used scaling/PCA. features merged internally selected HVGs rare-aware features validating present object. vars_to_regress Covariates regress ScaleData. resolution Resolution parameter FindClusters. Multiple values create separate cluster columns reusing graph dimensional reductions. cluster_algorithm Community-detection algorithm passed Seurat::FindClusters(). Supported names "louvain" (Seurat algorithm 1), "louvain_multilevel" (algorithm 2), "slm" (algorithm 3), "leiden" (algorithm 4). Numeric values 1 4 also accepted. Multiple explicitly supplied values form parameter-grid axis. cluster_name Optional metadata column name cluster labels. Defaults Seurat's "seurat_clusters" behavior. cluster_n_start, cluster_n_iter Number starts iterations passed Seurat::FindClusters(). cluster_group_singletons Whether Seurat::FindClusters() group singletons nearest cluster. leiden_method Leiden implementation passed Seurat::FindClusters() cluster_algorithm = "leiden". leiden_objective_function Leiden objective function passed Seurat::FindClusters(). assay Assay used consistently clustering stages; default RNA. layer Input expression layer, including corrected count layers. npcs Number PCs compute. Additional named clustering controls. Supported names include cluster_control, optional named list additional Seurat::FindClusters() arguments. Values override Shennong's generated defaults. reuse: logical; TRUE, reuse previously recorded sn_run_cluster() stages stored input signatures still match current call. lets resolution-changes start clustering, integration-method changes start integration, HVG changes start feature selection instead rerunning earlier steps. rerun_from: optional stage name forcing recomputation stage onward still allowing earlier matching stages reused. Supported values "normalize", "cell_cycle", "hvg", "pca", "adt", "integration", "neighbors", "clusters", "umap", "tsne". auto_install: logical; TRUE, install missing optional clustering dependencies leidenbase relevant stage. install_repos: CRAN-like repositories used auto_install installs CRAN packages. install_ask: passed BiocManager::install() auto_install installs Bioconductor packages sn_install_dependencies(). rare_feature_method: optional rare-cell-aware feature methods appended base HVG set PCA/clustering. Supported values "none", "gini", "local_markers". rare_feature_group_by: optional metadata column used define groups "local_markers". NULL, Shennong builds temporary coarse clustering base HVGs. rare_feature_n: number rare-aware features add per selected method. example, c("gini", "local_markers") rare_feature_n = 50 can contribute 100 rare-aware features de-duplication. Multiple values form parameter-grid axis. rare_feature_control: named list advanced rare-feature thresholds. Supported fields group_max_fraction, group_max_cells, gene_max_fraction, min_cells. block_genes: character vector bundled signature queries /custom gene symbols exclude internally selected HVGs. Signature queries can use leaf names "ribo" "cellCycle.G2M" full paths "Programs/cellCycle.G1S"; "g1s" "g2m" kept short aliases cell-cycle signatures. Applies log-normalization SCTransform workflows; explicit hvg_features preserved even overlap blocked signature. theta: theta parameter harmony::RunHarmony, controlling batch diversity preservation vs. correction. Used integration_method = "harmony". Multiple values expand Harmony branch duplicate integration methods. group_by_vars: optional column name character vector passed harmony::RunHarmony(group..vars = ...). Defaults batch_by used integration_method = "harmony". species: optional species label. Used block genes must resolved built-signatures. modality: workflow modality. "rna" runs standard RNA-workflow. "cite_seq" enables paired RNA+ADT workflows selected multimodal_method. multimodal_method: CITE-seq backend used modality = "cite_seq". "wnn" combines RNA PCA ADT PCA using Seurat's weighted nearest-neighbor workflow clusters "wsnn". "coralysis" runs native Coralysis ADT assay log-normalized protein matrix. "totalvi" runs scvi-tools totalVI RNA counts plus ADT counts clusters imported totalVI latent representation. "mmochi" runs MMoCHi ADT landmark registration across batches, single-sample mode batch_by = NULL, stores corrected protein matrix supported, computes protein PCA reduction, clusters reduction. NULL, Shennong keeps historical CITE-seq default "wnn" unless integration_method explicitly set one supported multimodal backends. adt_assay: assay containing antibody-derived tag counts modality = "cite_seq". adt_layer: layer adt_assay used ADT counts. adt_features: optional ADT/protein features used CITE-seq backends. Defaults features adt_assay. adt_npcs: number ADT PCs compute modality = "cite_seq". adt_dims: numeric vector ADT PCs used weighted nearest-neighbor graph construction. Defaults seq_len(min(18, adt_npcs)). wnn_control: optional named list additional Seurat::FindMultiModalNeighbors() arguments used modality = "cite_seq". Values override Shennong's generated defaults. umap_control: optional named list additional Seurat::RunUMAP() arguments. Values override Shennong's generated defaults, example n.neighbors, min.dist, spread, metric, seed.use, reduction.name. run_tsne: logical; run t-SNE addition UMAP. defaults FALSE, including multi-method parameter-grid runs. tsne_control: optional named list additional Seurat::RunTSNE() arguments. multi-method mode reduction name key generated per method overwrite another result. checkpoint_dir: optional directory persistent parameter-grid checkpoints. every completed run Shennong writes current object, comparison manifest, performance records, completed run IDs temporary file atomically publishes . latest complete checkpoint call signature retained. signature includes blockwise digest selected layer plus cell/feature identity metadata values used batching, grouped HVGs, regression, supervised integration. resume: logical; TRUE (default), resume matching checkpoint checkpoint_dir. content/metadata-aware signature also covers package version, grid, analysis arguments; incomplete .partial files ignored. checkpoint_compress: logical; compress RDS checkpoints. defaults FALSE faster writes cost disk space. return_cluster: TRUE, return cluster assignments. Multi-method calls return data frame one cluster column per method. verbose: whether print/log progress messages.
